Hyperliquid’s **$1 billion+ annual trading fee revenue**, most of which is funneled into daily HYPE buybacks. "The ETF market is betting on Hyperliquid’s revenue engine," said a CoinDesk analyst. "HYPE isn’t just another crypto—it’s a derivative of trading volume, and that’s what makes it unique."

The two tokens tell starkly different stories in the market. HYPE has surged **19% in the past week**, riding a wave of momentum that has it knocking on the door of new all-time highs.
